name: Blynk
description: Manage your IoT device fleet directly from Claude. Create device templates with datastreams and events, provision new devices, read live sensor data, and control outputs. The Blynk connector integrates with the Blynk IoT platform, enabling direct configuration and monitoring of connected devices and infrastructure.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Blynk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Blynk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://blynk.cloud/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Blynk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blynk lists 23 MCP tools, including search_devices, get_device, get_all_templates, get_template, create_template, create_datastream, edit_datastream, create_event, edit_event, create_device, update_datastream_value, and get_automation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Blynk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Blynk in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Blynk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Blynk is developed by Blynk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
